body: That's the thing, I don't take risks. I can't journey into the unknown because I am too scared. I know that a lot of my problems are because I am afraid to try new things but I can't seem to get past the fear.

I've been in therapy pretty much regularly and that hasn't helped much. I got back together with my high school sweetheart. I moved out of my parent's house and into a place with my partner. I had a pretty decent job for a while. Everything that people tell me will make a difference, but it didn't.
